points.quote: Firstly, check whether you are allowed to use AI in assignments and your course, the assignment brief and your tutors will be able to advise.
points.anchor: Can I use AI in my assignment?
points.gist: Check whether you are allowed to use AI in assignments; your course, the assignment brief and tutors can advise.

points.quote: Think about AI as a tool to help with your assignment, not create your assignment.
points.anchor: Can I use AI in my assignment?
points.gist: Think of AI as a tool to help with your assignment, not to create it.

points.quote: If you do use AI as a help tool, you will need to reference it in your assignment.
points.anchor: Can I use AI in my assignment?
points.gist: If you use AI as a help tool, you will need to reference it in your assignment.

points.quote: Login to Cite Them Right from the Referencing pages and go to the Digital & Internet section -> Software -> Generative AI (University log in required).
points.anchor: How to acknowledge and reference your use of AI in your assignment
points.gist: Cite Them Right (University login) has a Generative AI citation format under Digital & Internet, then Software.

points.quote: Best practice is to save a transcript, or a screen shot of the question you posed and the answer you got and add to your assignment as an appendix.
points.anchor: How to acknowledge and reference your use of AI in your assignment
points.gist: Best practice is to save a transcript or screenshot of your question and the answer and add it as an appendix.

points.quote: Yes, Turnitin can detect and provide an overall percentage of how much text has been AI generated.
points.anchor: Can AI be detected in assignments?
points.gist: Turnitin can detect and give an overall percentage of how much text has been AI generated.

points.quote: If AI text is generated and then included in an assignment as your own work, it would be considered under the university Academic Integrity Policy as work produced by a third party, and you may be asked to take part in a Viva to explain the score.
points.anchor: Can AI be detected in assignments?
points.gist: AI text included as your own work is treated under the Academic Integrity Policy as third-party work, and you may be asked to a Viva to explain the score.

points.quote: Cutting and pasting all or some of the content created by the AI used and not citing could be considered plagiarism.
points.anchor: Can AI be detected in assignments?
points.gist: Cutting and pasting AI content without citing could be considered plagiarism.

points.quote: Equally your tutor marking your assignment may have concerns that AI has been used to create the assignment. Triggers could be:
points.anchor: Can AI be detected in assignments?
points.gist: A marking tutor may have concerns that AI was used, based on certain triggers.

points.anchor: Can AI be detected in assignments?
points.gist: References that are not genuine and available may trigger tutor concern about AI use.

points.quote: BUT the content it pulls together may be false and inaccurate. Just like with Wikipedia you cannot just accept it.
points.anchor: Can I use AI in my assignment?
points.gist: AI content may be false and inaccurate, so you cannot just accept it, as with Wikipedia.

points.quote: Within the library collection there are more reliable scholarly resources such as Credo to check facts and get concepts and ideas.
points.anchor: Can I use AI in my assignment?
points.gist: The library collection has more reliable scholarly resources such as Credo to check facts and get concepts and ideas.

points.quote: Check if the citations it provides are correct as it is predicting text, not trawling for suitable and appropriate references to articles or books.
points.gist: AI cannot check whether its citations are correct, because it predicts text rather than searching for suitable references.

points.quote: Because AI is organic and ever growing, you cannot repeat the questions and get the same answer.
points.anchor: How to acknowledge and reference your use of AI in your assignment
points.gist: Because AI is ever growing, repeating a question will not give the same answer.
